title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_die_pantelides_dynastie_3_teilige_serie_by_maya_blake_glcqq (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_die_pantelides_dynastie_3_teilige_serie_by_maya_blake_glcqq' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be considered exposed and require immediate rotation from a different, uncompromised device. Removal of the package alone may not fully eliminate the malicious presence due to potential additional malware installed.
